method: Official Intel PDFs opened and relevant text read through the web tool. No complete download or PDF hash claimed.

sources.source: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual Volume 2A, 253666-060US, September 2016
facts: CMP obtains status flags from the first operand minus the second without storing that result.
INC preserves CF while updating OF, SF, ZF, AF and PF from the incremented result.
Short opcode75 JNE/JNZ takes its branch when ZF is zero.

sources.source: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual Volume 2C, 326018-060US, September 2016
facts: XOR clears CF and OF, derives SF/ZF/PF from its result, and leaves AF architecturally undefined.

limits: ISA corroboration only. A defined-flags/mask view is not a raw PUSHF image. CPU-specific reserved/undefined flag images, actual CPU behavior, historical timing, IRQ/DOS/game sessions and fidelity remain separate.
